description: Curated corpus contract for Upgrade-v2 trust architecture evidence. The current entries point to registered local H.264 assets; external public-dataset entries can be added without changing benchmark code.

entries.selection: all existing registered local H.264 assets

promotion_requirements: Add non-local or externally curated real-video assets.
Record source, license, codec/container, resolution, frame count, and hash for every external asset.
Keep local, synthetic, and external-public metrics separated in output JSON.
Do not claim broad public-dataset robustness until external_public_dataset is true and section 45 gates pass.
